An agent's box, as environments/&lt;name&gt;.yaml.

Fields are listed in the schema's order, each nested under the field that holds it. The fields under an array are those of each of its elements, and the fields under a map are those of each of its values.

## kind

`"Environment"`, required.

## spec

object, required.

- `size`: one of `"small"`, `"large"`. How big the box is.
- `tools`: array of string, at most 5 items.
- `mcp`: map of object.
  - `url`: string. Remote: the URL.
  - `command`: array of string, at least 1 item.
  - Rules:
    - Exactly one of `url` or `command` is set.
